summary: Publishes the incoming SOP geometry as a component output connector with an optional hover label.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Text shown when hovering over the component output connector

common_gotchas: Out SOP is a boundary publishing operator, so it should usually sit at a stable final geometry point in a component.
Output ordering follows alphanumeric operator names, which matters when exposing multiple SOP outputs.
The label only changes the connector hover text; it does not rename the operator or generate geometry.
key_concepts: Creates a SOP output on the containing component so geometry can leave the component boundary.
The connected input geometry is the published output; Out SOP does not generate geometry by itself.
Multiple outputs on a component are ordered alphanumerically by operator name.
